questions.question: What were the unadjusted total retail and food services sales in millions of dollars for the full year 2025?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2025', header=None)
# Look for 'Retail and food services sales, total' under NOT ADJUSTED
mask = df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Retail and food services sales, total'
row_idx = df[mask].index[0]
# Total column is column O (index 14)
result = int(df.iloc[row_idx, 14])

questions.question: In 2024, did unadjusted sales at grocery stores exceed 850,000 million dollars for the entire year?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2024', header=None)
mask = (df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '4451') & (df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Grocery stores')
val = float(df.loc[mask, 14].values[0])
result = 'yes' if val > 850000 else 'no'

questions.question: Between furniture stores and electronics stores, which business type had higher unadjusted total annual sales in 2023?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2023', header=None)
furn = float(df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '4421', 14].values[0])
elec = float(df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '443142', 14].values[0])
result = 'Furniture stores' if furn > elec else 'Electronics stores'

result = df.iloc[furniture_row, 1] if furniture_total > electronics_total else df.iloc[electronics_row, 1]

questions.question: In 2020, which month recorded the lowest unadjusted sales for food services and drinking places?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2020', header=None)
row = df[(df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '722') & (df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Food services and drinking places')].iloc[0]
months = ['2020-01', '2020-02', '2020-03', '2020-04', '2020-05', '2020-06', '2020-07', '2020-08', '2020-09', '2020-10', '2020-11', '2020-12']
sales = [float(row[c]) for c in range(2, 14)]
s = pd.Series(sales, index=months)
result = str(s.idxmin())

not_adj_df = df.iloc[:adjusted_idx]

dt = pd.to_datetime(min_month_str.replace('.', ''))
result = dt.strftime('%Y-%m')

questions.question: What was the average monthly seasonally adjusted total retail and food services sales in millions of dollars across all twelve months of 2022?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2022', header=None)
# Row 72 in Excel is row index 71: ADJUSTED Retail and food services sales, total
adjusted_row = df[df[1].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Retail and food services sales, total'].iloc[1]
vals = [float(adjusted_row[c]) for c in range(2, 14)]
result = float(sum(vals) / len(vals))

questions.question: How much higher were unadjusted sales at new car dealers than used car dealers in millions of dollars for the full year 2021?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_monthly_retail_trade_sales.xlsx', sheet_name='2021', header=None)
new_car = float(df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '44111', 14].values[0])
used_car = float(df.loc[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == '44112', 14].values[0])
result = int(new_car - used_car)
